verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own docs show it running a quantized GGUF model (phi-2.Q8_0.gguf) and supporting ggml/gguf models in general, so the product does load integer-quantized weights at least at 8-bit. Nothing in the evidence documents the lower-bit end of the range or presents quantization as a way to cut memory. Missing for 10: evidence of very low-bit (e.g., 2–4 bit) quantization support, documentation of the range of supported quantization levels, memory-footprint guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
